existing.funding_period: one-off tuition fee discount on the first year of study
existing.description: The University of Leeds offers a set of merit scholarships worth £3,000, £6,000 or £16,000 to international students applying to eligible taught Master's courses starting in September 2027. The award is paid as a tuition fee discount on the first year of study only and cannot be used towards maintenance or accommodation costs. Applicants must already hold a conditional or unconditional offer and then submit a separate scholarship application; two rounds are scheduled for 28 February 2027 and 16 May 2027.
eligibility: Classified as an international student for fee purposes
Hold a conditional or unconditional offer for an eligible full-time taught Master's course starting in September 2027
Predicted or achieved minimum of a Bachelor's degree with a 2:1 (hons) or equivalent
Demonstrate an excellent academic track record
existing.eligibility_summary: International (non-UK) fee-status applicants holding a conditional or unconditional offer for an eligible full-time taught Master's course starting September 2027, who are self-funded or partially funded and hold a Bachelor's degree equivalent to a 2:1 (hons) or better.
coverage: Partial tuition fee discount on the first year of study only
requirements: Scholarship application form submitted after receiving an admission offer
Demonstrate excellent professional and personal skills evidenced through work experience and/or extracurricular activities
application_method: Submit the University of Leeds scholarship application form; offer holders are notified by email with details of how to apply
A separate scholarship application is required for each course if you hold offers for multiple courses
existing.selection_notes: Awards recognise and reward high academic achievement. The final scholarship awarded to an applicant is determined by the University and all decisions are final.
existing.notes: The MBA programme is excluded because it runs its own MBA Excellence Scholarship scheme, and all fully online courses are excluded.
existing.application_period: Applications for September 2027 taught Master's courses open 1 October 2026; scholarship round one closes 28 February 2027 and round two 16 May 2027.
